scope: Candidate A complete bounded code-area review at exact supplied source hashes; standard-library worker-host API, Go 1.22 minimum.

coverage.reason: Applicable: the host-supplied Lease protocol, injected Open dependency, cancellation/error propagation and cohort ownership are design boundaries; reviewed API, ownership and composition without demanding another framework.
Applicable: reviewed local state transitions, result collection, checked errors, context guards, docs, value/closure semantics under go 1.22; gofmt and vet independently executed.

Applicable: reviewed every README result/lifecycle obligation, API shape, empty/finite/open input, partial acquisition, all three failure stages, cancellation before/during/stopping, successful effects and supported Go minimum.

Applicable: reviewed candidate host_test.go assertions, doubles, event gates, cleanup and whether meaningful contract violations evade its authored suite. External held/supplementary/independent probes verify behavior; they are not additions to the candidate regression suite.

Not applicable within this bounded trusted-host API: Job is a caller-supplied integer; Open and Lease are trusted collaborators; there is no demonstrated attacker, authorization boundary, sensitive sink, credential, cryptographic or network/file parsing decision. General resource failures are not recast as vulnerabilities. No advisory scan or security assessment of an unspecified host is claimed.

Applicable: cancellation, stop propagation, failure containment, joining actual cleanup and errors.Is diagnostics are the available library signals. No service telemetry, retries or arbitrary timeout requirement is inferred.

Applicable: limit bounds acquired leases through Close, cohort completion controls goroutines/resources, and available capacity must be used. Assessed scaling/lifetime and bounded event counts; no microbenchmark or production latency claim.

Applicable: go.mod declares Go 1.22 and standard-library-only production/tests. Verified standalone readonly resolution, host and actual minimum compilation/test execution, imports, module graph and exact input hashes. No generated/native/release inputs or bit-identical artifact contract.

Not applicable to the bounded library code area: no configured release artifact, CI/promotion path, process signals, container, runtime configuration, health/routing or grace budget decision is supplied or promised. Host deployment evidence is unavailable outside scope and excluded, not reported as passing. Library lifecycle is assessed by the applicable topics.

findings.cause: Close failures are appended but never enter the stop state before the next cohort.
findings.evidence: candidates/A/host.go:60; candidates/A/host.go:85; evidence/A-host-independent.log: TestIndependentCloseFailureStopsNextAdmission; evidence/A-minimum-independent.log: same intended assertion; evidence/A-host-race.log: repeated intended assertion; At limit 1, three leases are opened/closed after the first Close fails, where the contract permits only one; unbounded input would continue admissions after observed failure. Contained important admission contract failure, not systemic/critical.
findings.correction: Have closeCohort set stop/cancel on any Close error, while still closing all owned leases exactly once.

findings.cause: Successful Open results can start Run using only stale stop state without rechecking caller/work context.
findings.evidence: candidates/A/host.go:143; candidates/A/host.go:174; evidence/stress-commands.json: 3 forbidden Runs in 2000 concurrent valid calls on host race build; evidence/minimum-stress-command.json: 1, 1 and 6 forbidden Runs per 2000 calls on actual minimum race build; Open deliberately cancels the caller context before returning its nonnil lease successfully. If its buffered result and cancellation are both ready, selecting the result starts Run after stopping; acquired lease must instead be owned and closed without Run. Reach is one host call; major contract failure.
findings.correction: After collecting/owning the Open result, observe context cancellation and set stop before starting Run; retain cancellation cause.

findings.cause: Final join/Close cleanup does not observe caller cancellation again before returning accumulated errors.
findings.evidence: candidates/A/host.go:181; candidates/A/host.go:183; evidence/A-host-independent.log: TestIndependentCallerCancellationDuringFailureCleanup; evidence/A-minimum-independent.log: same intended error identity assertion; After a Run failure, canceling the caller while a gated Close is held loses context.Canceled, although independent Run and Close errors remain inspectable. This breaks the explicit stopping-time diagnostic contract at the single Serve boundary.
findings.correction: Append the caller cancellation observed after owned cleanup before returning, without dropping independent errors.

findings.cause: No authored Close-only failure test asserts that subsequent queued jobs are never opened.
findings.evidence: candidates/A/host_test.go:107; candidates/A/host_test.go:140; evidence/A-host-authored.log: authored suite passes unchanged defective implementation; evidence/A-host-independent.log: Close-only next-admission assertion fails; An important explicit stop-admission contract evades regression detection because the Close sentinel is paired with an already stopping Run failure. Independent test correction is required even after P1 is fixed.
findings.correction: Add a healthy Run followed by failing Close with later queued jobs and an exact Open count.

findings.cause: Cancellation-during-Open fixture asserts release but never asserts that returned leases skip Run.
findings.evidence: candidates/A/host_test.go:151; evidence/stress-commands.json: forbidden Runs under valid cancellation-before-success; evidence/A-host-authored.log: cancellation test and full authored suite pass; The explicit never-start-after-stop contract is unchecked despite a fixture already returning a lease after cancellation; a forbidden extra Run is accepted by the test.
findings.correction: Add a Run counter/forbidden event and assert zero Runs plus owned release; cover simultaneously ready Open-result/cancellation.

findings.cause: No authored assertion retains caller cancellation introduced during final held failure cleanup.
findings.evidence: candidates/A/host_test.go:107; candidates/A/host_test.go:151; evidence/A-host-authored.log: authored suite passes; evidence/A-host-independent.log: errors.Is cancellation fails after gated Close; Independent Run/Close error checks and initial cancellation checks do not cover cancellation observed while stopping, an explicit important diagnostic requirement.
findings.correction: Gate final Close after an independent Run failure, cancel the caller, and assert all independent causes plus cancellation.

findings.cause: Failure fixture expects two acquired leases without ensuring second acquisition precedes the first Run failure.
findings.evidence: candidates/A/host_test.go:107; candidates/A/host_test.go:135; evidence/stress-commands.json: authored TestServeFailureJoinsAndClosesOwnedLeases reports closed=1 in 3 of 1000 race repetitions with GOMAXPROCS=16; A legal early stop leaves only the first lease acquired and released; the test produces a false failure. This is a localized meaningful scheduling fragility, moderate rather than an unverified production defect.
findings.correction: Use an explicit second-acquisition/second-start gate before releasing the failing first Run; assert releases only for leases actually acquired.

strengths.evidence: The exact Job/Lease/Serve API remains compatible and construction stays host-owned through the Open function, with no unrelated framework/public API; both actual toolchains compile every source package.

Actual go1.22.12 and go1.26.5 compile the standalone go 1.22 standard-library-only module with GOWORK=off, GOTOOLCHAIN=local, GOFLAGS=-mod=readonly; go list -m all returns only example.com/service-owned-workers. No external go.sum is needed.
